PrivateType is a private, local push-to-talk dictation app for Windows. Hold a shortcut, speak, and release it to insert text into the field where dictation began, without cloud recognition. Nothing you say is written to disk.

## New in this release

### Faster transcription on your graphics card

- **The model runs on the fastest device it finds:** a graphics card, then integrated graphics, then the processor. A device is used when it has at least 1 GiB free. Measured with Parakeet on a laptop, 70 seconds of speech took about 1.9 s on an NVIDIA MX450, 6.5 s on Intel UHD integrated graphics, and 15 s on the processor alone.
- **Settings → Model → Run model on** shows the device in use. Choose **Processor only** to save battery. If a graphics card fails to start, the line turns amber and PrivateType uses the processor until you restart it.

### Long dictations keep their ending

- **Text no longer stops partway through a long dictation.** The speech model could stop writing partway through a long dictation, so the end of what you said was missing. When the microphone heard you speaking past the last recognized word, PrivateType now transcribes the rest and adds it.
- **The live preview keeps up however long you speak.** It used to slow down the longer a dictation ran, and could look frozen.
- **The last syllable is no longer clipped.** Audio still arriving when you release the shortcut now reaches the text, and the release sound plays once the microphone has stopped.

### Fixes

- The bubble stays above other windows. Windows could leave it behind them, so dictation worked with no visible bubble.
- The bubble stays on screen at display scaling above 100%.

### Diagnostics

- Each dictation now records how long the microphone heard speech and where the text ended, as numbers only, so a cut-off dictation can be diagnosed from **Settings → Diagnostics**. No audio or dictated text is recorded.

## Download and start

1. Download `PrivateType-1.5.0-win-x64.zip` and `PrivateType-1.5.0-win-x64.zip.sha256` below.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder.
4. Open `PrivateType 1.5.0` and double-click `PrivateType.exe`.
5. If you used an earlier version, accept the offer to import its settings. Otherwise, choose a speech model and approve its separate download if it is not already in the shared cache.

Speech models are not bundled in the ZIP. PrivateType downloads the one you choose directly from NVIDIA on Hugging Face and verifies its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use. Models already downloaded by versions 1.2.0 and later are reused.

## Requirements

- 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11 with an x86-64 CPU. No graphics card is needed, but one makes transcription several times faster.
- 8 GB RAM recommended. The loaded model uses about 0.8–1.4 GiB of memory, or graphics memory instead when it runs on a graphics card.
- About 1.2 GB free disk space for the app, one model, and working room
- [Microsoft Visual C++ x64 Redistributable](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist), if it isn't already installed

## Privacy

Speech recognition runs locally. PrivateType has no account, cloud-recognition fallback, telemetry, or retained audio. Recent dictations stay in memory only and can be turned off in Settings. The shared settings file stores preferences and vocabulary, never audio or dictated text. Review diagnostic reports before sharing them because application diagnostics can still contain information about your computer environment.
